notes.title: MCS Update: QOL AUTOSAVE Update and Translations
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38032352/c2aa499d0630ea03dcd08f082090a9a325230059.png[/img]

[h3]Big Thank you to everyone!! (A bit late on this announcement.. sorry! We we're dealing with Tower and Sword!)[/h3]

First would like to thank all of you for supporting Libraheart and Pixeltehshoku. Midnight Castle has sold exceptionally well and the devs are incredibly pleased with all the results. With that being said they have been working hard to fix little issues and get quality of life updates out as fast as possible.

[i][b]So what's new this time?[/b][/i]

While we can't fix every individuals crashing issues. We can at least give you guys AUTOSAVES. From now on ever single new room you enter will now be saved in the game. if you want to continue from when you started you can now just press continue on the Title Screen.

We have fixed a lot of little bugs and issues some people are having. we haven't fixed all of them mind you but this release has given Pixel a lot of useful information to ensure Castle in The Clouds has a much smoother launch. 

For those who are paying attention you will notice now that there a prompt to select your language when the game starts. We have been putting in Translations as fast as we can to meet international depend. At the moment, English, Chinese (simplified), Russian, and Korean are available , but we will have the rest of these options done very soon. 

Midnight Castle surpassed over 16K sales in its first week of release. Thank you very much guys. 

[h2]Translation[/h2]

The success of the release has. We were trying to convince Pixel of this before, but he was unsure if it would be worth the effort due to him and Libraheart's low sales on dlsite. Thanks to our efforts and your support this will no longer be an issue anymore and he is [i][b]very eager[/b][/i] to support translations for this game and Castle in the Clouds.

Expect multi-language support REALLY soon!

For those of you having a great time [i][b]make sure to leave a review![/b][/i] Thanks for your support you guys have changed the lives of these two devs. Now with a proper budget... good things are to come!
________________________________________

notes.title: Midnight Castle Succubus to soon release Uncensored!
notes.content:
[h2]We'll give you guys a break at not release at Midnight PST.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38032352/02577a512057f225d73abc1a8b22b7e0824325a8.png[/img]

We'll be releasing this title in a few hours instead! [i][b]With no censorship in sight![/b][/i] Midnight will release at 12.99$ with a 10% discount.

The CB Sound Team made an original, snazzy as fuckl ost for this game (it was previously using royalty free music). We are sadly still waiting for Steam to approve the OST. The soundtrack OST  will be available as as it gets approved for those who want the highest quality rips (MP3 and FLAC format). We are quite certain your will be impressed with what we cooked up for this dev. We decided to not follow too much into Castlevania's shoes and[i][b] do a bit of experimentation.[/b][/i]Hopefully you guys love it.

We would like to thank Pixel and Libraheart for entrusting their games with us. They fit perfectly in our environment and fit the vision we want to move towards (hentai games that are actually fun to play).

Thanks for the support guys. Hope you have a great time!
